title: BEACON D5 damage / needs assessment (FR-D4-4, FEV-23)
description: The wire shape of the damage & needs assessment (src/application/coordination/damage-assessment.ts). Structurally there is ONE BUCKET PER TRIAGE STATE and NO grand total: a figure that mixes VERIFIED with UNVERIFIED reports cannot be expressed in this document, which is the point (Art. XIII — no public action originates from an unverified report). `verified` is the VERIFIED bucket repeated for callers that must quote only verified figures; `unverifiedLabel` is the exact wording every other figure must carry. AGGREGATE-ONLY (Art. XIV): every leaf is a COUNT. There is no casualty, injury, age or person field anywhere — an aggregate casualty tally is FR-D6-5 and belongs to the D6 lane.

byTriageStatus.description: PUBLIC_REPORT_STATUSES verbatim (src/domain/public-report.ts:12) — one bucket per state, pinned by test.

bySeverity.description: DAMAGE_SEVERITIES verbatim — aggregate SITE-level severity, never a person's condition.

byNeed.description: NEED_KINDS verbatim — sector-level unmet needs, never an individual's need.

siteCount.description: Σ of self-reported affected SITE counts in this bucket — structures/parcels, never people.

worstSeverity.description: Worst severity present in this bucket; absent when the bucket carries no severity.
